text.en: My hands, my hair, my tummy. All of me belongs to me.
text.hg: Mere haath, mere baal, mera pet. Mera sab kuch mera apna hai.

text.en: You can say 'No, thank you' to a hug, a kiss or a tickle, even to grown-ups.
text.hg: Hug, pappi ya gudgudi ke liye tum 'Nahi, thank you' bol sakte ho, badon se bhi.

text.en: Ask, 'Can I hug you?' If your friend says no, stop.
text.hg: Poocho, 'Kya main tumhe hug kar loon?' Dost 'no' bole, toh ruk jao.

text.en: Parts under your underwear are private. Nobody should touch them or ask to see them.
text.hg: Underwear se dhake parts private hain. Koi unhe touch na kare, na dekhne ko bole.

text.en: Does a secret feel scary or yucky? Tell a grown-up you trust. It is never your fault.
text.hg: Koi secret darawna ya ganda-sa lage? Kisi bharosemand bade ko batao. Isme tumhari galti kabhi nahi hoti.

title.en: Ask, listen and respect a no
title.hg: Poocho, suno aur 'no' ki respect karo

text.en: Before doing something that affects someone, ask: 'Can I borrow your pen?' 'Can I post this photo?'
text.hg: Kisi par asar daalne wala kaam karne se pehle poocho: 'Kya main tumhara pen le loon?' 'Kya main yeh photo post karoon?'

text.en: A real yes is free and happy. A shrug, silence or 'umm, okay' after begging is not.
text.hg: Real yes apni marzi aur khushi se aati hai. Shrug, chuppi ya bahut manane ke baad 'umm, okay' real yes nahi hai.

text.en: A yes can change. If someone says stop in the middle, the game ends right there.
text.hg: Yes badal sakti hai. Koi beech mein 'stop' bole, toh game wahin khatam.

text.en: Say 'okay' and move on. No sulking, teasing or asking again.
text.hg: 'Okay' bolo aur aage badho. Na muh phulana, na tease karna, na baar-baar poochna.

text.en: 'No. Stop. I don't like it.' Tricks, gifts or secrets? Tell a trusted adult or call 1098.
text.hg: 'Nahi. Ruko. Mujhe yeh pasand nahi.' Tricks, gifts ya secrets? Kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 pe call karo.

text.en: No pressure, threats or guilt. A yes squeezed out by pressure does not count.
text.hg: Na pressure, na dhamki, na guilt. Pressure se nikalwayi gayi yes count nahi hoti.

text.en: You know exactly what you are agreeing to.
text.hg: Tumhe exactly pata hai ki tum kis baat ke liye yes bol rahe ho.

text.en: Yes to one thing is not yes to everything.
text.hg: Ek cheez ke liye yes har cheez ke liye yes nahi hai.

text.en: Silence, 'maybe', a nervous laugh or freezing is not a yes.
text.hg: Chuppi, 'maybe', nervous hansi ya freeze ho jaana yes nahi hai.

text.en: Anyone can change their mind at any moment, and then the other person must stop.
text.hg: Koi bhi kisi bhi pal apna mann badal sakta hai, aur tab saamne wale ko rukna hi hoga.

text.en: Under POCSO, a person under 18 cannot legally consent to sexual activity. Waiting is always valid.
text.hg: POCSO ke under 18 se kam umar ka person sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta. Wait karna hamesha valid hai.

title.hg: Kya yeh yes sach mein free hai?

points.en: Both people can refuse without losing marks, money or safety
points.hg: Dono bina marks, paisa ya safety khoye mana kar sakte hain

points.en: Both are sober enough to understand and choose
points.hg: Dono itne hosh mein hain ki samajh sakein aur choose kar sakein

points.en: Each new step gets its own free yes
points.hg: Har naye step ke liye alag se free yes

points.en: Refusing a teacher, coach or boss could cost you
points.hg: Teacher, coach ya boss ko mana karna mehenga pad sakta hai

points.en: Gifts, flirting or a visit treated as 'you owe me'
points.hg: Gifts, flirting ya ghar aane ko 'ab tum par udhaar hai' maan lena

points.en: Someone heavily drunk, drugged or unable to speak clearly
points.hg: Bahut zyada nashe mein ya saaf bol na paane wala insaan

points.en: Under 18: no legal consent under POCSO; their sexual images are illegal to keep or forward
points.hg: 18 se kam: POCSO ke under legal consent nahi; unki sexual images rakhna ya forward karna illegal hai

title.hg: Adults ke beech consent, har baar

points.en: A clear yes each time, for each activity
points.hg: Har baar, har activity ke liye clear yes

points.en: Checking in with 'Is this okay?' and watching body language
points.hg: Beech-beech mein 'Yeh okay hai?' poochna aur body language pe dhyaan dena

points.en: Given by someone sober enough to understand and choose
points.hg: Aise insaan ki yes jo samajhne aur choose karne layak hosh mein ho

points.en: Stopping at once when a partner says stop
points.hg: Partner ke 'stop' bolte hi turant ruk jaana

points.en: 'We're married' or 'you said yes last night'
points.hg: 'Hum married hain' ya 'kal raat toh yes bola tha'

points.en: Removing a condom without your partner knowing
points.hg: Partner ko bataye bina condom hata dena

points.en: A yes from someone slurring, stumbling or drifting off
points.hg: Ladkhadaati zubaan, dagmagaate kadam ya neend mein dhulakte insaan ki yes
'Aaj nahi' ke baad muh phulana ya bargain karna

title.en: If someone tells you they were harmed
title.hg: Jab koi bataye ki uske saath galat hua

text.en: Stay calm. Say: 'I believe you. It's not your fault. Thank you for telling me.'
text.hg: Calm raho. Bolo: 'Mujhe tumhari baat pe yakeen hai. Yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Batane ke liye thank you.'

text.en: Skip 'why' questions, do not push for details, and do not confront the person who did it.
text.hg: 'Kyun' wale sawaal mat poocho, details ke liye force mat karo, aur jisne yeh kiya usse khud confront mat karo.

text.en: If they are under 18 or in danger, do not promise secrecy. Stay with them while you tell someone who can help.
text.hg: Agar woh 18 se kam hain ya danger mein hain, toh secret rakhne ka promise mat karo. Help kar sakne wale kisi insaan ko batate waqt unke saath raho.

text.en: In danger: 112. Under 18: 1098. Women: 181. Online abuse: 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
text.hg: Danger mein: 112. 18 se kam: 1098. Women: 181. Online abuse: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in.

text.en: Go even with no visible injury. HIV-prevention medicine must start within 72 hours; emergency contraception works up to 5 days.
text.hg: Chot na dikhe tab bhi jao. HIV-prevention medicine 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye; emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai.
